ex.en: Iron oxidizes when exposed to air and water.
ex.zh: 鐵接觸到空氣和水就會氧化。

ex.en: The apple slices oxidized and turned brown.
ex.zh: 蘋果切片氧化變成褐色。

ex.en: We yawn when we are short of oxygen.
ex.zh: 我們缺氧的時候會打哈欠。

ex.en: Trees give off oxygen and absorb carbon dioxide.
ex.zh: 樹木會釋放氧氣、吸收二氧化碳。

ex.en: Water is made up of oxygen and hydrogen.
